event_data.context:
Preserve AGENTS.md and the owning crate contracts. Record pinned Rust and WebUI toolchains, test-first and integration coverage requirements, signed small commits, independent review, and protected squash delivery.
Add a template and ADR policy under docs/internal/adr/. Require one new numbered ADR per architectural decision and pair it with a substantive change to its owning current-architecture document in the same source commit and eventual squash commit. Preserve merged decisions except a status-only supersession linking the new ADR. Adopt prospectively and preserve legacy records. Use a narrow repository-native checker in Code Style for structural rules on PRs and main, with test fixtures for invalid structure, immutable records, multiple new ADRs, missing pairs, and accepted supersession. Independent review verifies correspondence and authority.
event_data.summary: Record the fork’s engineering workflow in repository guidance and enforce a prospective ADR policy using Code Style.
event_data.title: Adopt coding and architecture decision standards
